censuses.headline: The data plane is CSV-tabular (below the bar, not masquerade). The ONE masquerade is load-bearing: THE CLAIM CONTRACT -- the field schema every ledger derives from -- exists only as a markdown table in evidence-model.md.

An honest, boundary-declared negative: every compiled-from source of record is JSON/YAML; every markdown member is a derived render or an honest provenance record with zero programmatic consumers (0/8060 py files, measured). The Kimi daily report is the POSITIVE pattern: absence-as-state everywhere, denominators in-band.
censuses.self_test: the census passes its own same-fields test mechanically (12/12 rows, identical seven fields, verified pre-commit)

combined_verdict: THE DISEASE IS REAL BUT RARE, AND IT CONCENTRATES AT THE SCHEMA-DEFINING LAYER. Both sides' worst instances are schemas that exist only as prose or discipline -- ATOM_DECOMP's claim contract (a markdown table) and SYSTEM_DEFINITIONS' enforcement (perfect 51/51 conformance held by discipline, no control). The cure everywhere is cheap gates and declared schemas, not rewrites.

process_lessons.lesson: DECLARATION OVER BACKFILL: where structured-SSOT (same fields per row) meets an append-only carrier (history is immutable bytes), the carrier's own rules outrank the format ruling -- absence in history is cured by a reading-rule DECLARATION, never by rewriting rows. Measured: the rcg manifest gate REFUSED a content-preserving backfill, and the refusal became the precedent cited inside the landed fix.
process_lessons.cvo_precision: the SYSTEM_DEFINITIONS schema gate binds the PRESENT state of a versioned registry; if the file ever grows an append-only history section, that section takes the declaration pattern, not the lint

process_lessons.lesson: A REFUSED COMMIT'S STAGE IS LIVE RESIDUE: safe-commit stages before the gate fires, and a bare `git checkout -- <file>` restores from the INDEX -- the 'revert' restored the refused edit while reporting success. Restore from HEAD explicitly and verify against the pre-state distribution. Kept in this package as the known_negative proving the revert check discriminates.

THE RULING'S OWN BOUNDARY, applied consistently on both sides: markdown is banned as an SSOT/compiled-from carrier, not as documentation -- prose rules, rationale and honest provenance records are legitimate; the five frozen contract-records' masquerade RISK was retired by the marker headers landed earlier the same day (live-carrier-wins + do-not-cite-numbers-as-current).
